pictures.name: JHB1-Leaving-Class
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. A sunny ancient street of pale stone in Jerusalem. Hillel, an elderly, gentle teacher with a white beard and kind eyes, in a plain cream wool robe and a deep blue mantle, walks out of a study house doorway, and his students, young men in robes of sand, olive and rust, walk with him, talking and curious. Market stalls and arches behind them. Warm gold afternoon light, deep blue shadows.
